description: MeisterTask is the work management platform transforming how teams get work done. Hosted in Germany and built on simplicity, it brings together projects, tasks, and documentation in one place. The MeisterTask MCP server connects a MeisterTask workspace to ChatGPT. Once authorized, ChatGPT can plan and structure projects from a brief or goal, search across tasks, projects, and notes, capture meeting notes as MeisterTask Notes, turn action items into assigned tasks, summarize overdue, due, and recently completed work for standups or weekly reviews, and read or edit Notes to keep team documentation up to date as work progresses.
